title: Indonesia Energy Governance, Regulatory Watch and CCS/CCUS Intelligence
scope: Public research snapshot; functional governance map and selected CCS/CCUS projects, not an exhaustive licensing or investment register.

governance.warning: Actor map shows relationships between policy, regulation, shareholding, project contracts and oversight, not a single reporting hierarchy. Under UU 16/2025, Danantara manages the state's Series B BUMN economic interests and BP BUMN holds strategic Series A Dwiwarna rights. Danantara does not directly regulate upstream PSCs or supervise private operators (BUMS). Direct corporate-shareholding statements require company-specific verification.

strategic_readout: Two separate SOE governance dimensions: BP BUMN acts as SOE regulator / Series A state shareholder representative; Danantara acts as portfolio owner-manager for Series B economic interests; directors and subsidiaries conduct their own operations.

Oil & Gas accountability must be traced distinctly: ESDM/Dirjen Migas policy and licences → SKK Migas/BPMA for upstream PSC execution → private or SOE contractors/KKKS → downstream BPH Migas and commercial operators.

Decision rights do not form a single hierarchy: Presidency/DEN and the special adviser drive direction; Kemenko coordinates; ESDM and other ministries regulate; SKK Migas/BPH and local administrations supervise assigned domains; operators deliver assets.

Energy politics has two parliamentary interfaces: Komisi XII scrutinises energy regulation, SKK/BPH and energy subsidies; Komisi VI examines Pertamina as an SOE. Komisi VII handles downstream industry, while XI and Banggar track fiscal consequences.

DPD Komite II feeds regional resource and infrastructure priorities into national debate, while Komite IV flags regional fiscal transfers and DBH; neither directly licenses a CCS storage permit or instructs corporate management.

The 2026 Pertamina downstream consolidation should not be analysed as the pre-2026 separate PPN/KPI/PIS operator structure; parent Pertamina, upstream PHE and downstream Patra Niaga have different management and assets.

accountability_routes.assessment: Never equate draft APBN, enacted allocations, subsidies actually paid, state compensation, or fuel dispatched.

accountability_routes.strategic: President/DEN, new Kemenko Hilirisasi dan Transisi Energi; Investment Ministry/BKPM
accountability_routes.regulators: ESDM technical permitting, Industry Ministry factory policy, KLH/BPLH safeguard, Kemenkeu incentives
accountability_routes.operators: Danantara via its SOE portfolio and transaction-specific holdings; BP BUMN retains shareholder/regulatory functions; corporate boards of Pertamina and PLN, plus independently contracted private investors/KKKS/IPPs, execute projects.
accountability_routes.oversight: DPR XII energy/investment, DPR VII industry, DPR VI SOEs, DPD Komite II regional development
accountability_routes.regional: Provincial investors, ports, industrial estates, BP Batam/KEK zones, utilities
accountability_routes.assessment: Separate investment pipeline, final financing, paid-in capital, construction expenditure and commercial operation.

accountability_routes.issue: Upstream oil & gas: PSC, lifting and investment
accountability_routes.strategic: ESDM / Ditjen Migas set working-area and technical policy; national upstream targets and investment priorities remain ministerial / government decisions, separate from Danantara shareholding.
accountability_routes.regulators: SKK Migas manages PSC execution outside Aceh; BPMA is the relevant special upstream authority in Aceh. BP BUMN regulates SOE corporate interests, not the PSC operating approvals.
accountability_routes.operators: Pertamina Hulu Energi as a state-owned group contractor and independent private/international KKKS including Medco, ExxonMobil, bp, INPEX, Searah JV execute their own licensed working-area agreements.
accountability_routes.oversight: DPR XII for energy/PSC policy; DPR VI for BUMN corporate performance; DPR XI/Banggar for oil and gas fiscal assumptions; DPD II for regional effects.
accountability_routes.regional: Field production sites, district/regional planning interfaces, community safeguards and site facilities under their respective legal delegation.
accountability_routes.assessment: Do not treat Danantara BUMN economic holdings as an ownership chain over SKK Migas or BUMS operators. Measure reserves, production and lifting separately; verify WP&B, PoD, FID, capex, first gas/oil and acquired stakes only when the transaction closes.

accountability_routes.issue: Industrial gas, LNG and household gas networks
accountability_routes.strategic: National gas allocation and HGBT industrial policy, supply security, gas/LNG imports and domestic offtake priorities are government and ESDM decisions.
accountability_routes.regulators: Ditjen Migas regulates sectoral supply and gas pricing policy; SKK Migas / BPMA for upstream contract and allocation interfaces; BPH Migas for assigned gas-pipeline transportation and certain downstream oversight.
accountability_routes.operators: Upstream: state and private KKKS, including bp, INPEX, Medco and Searah. Infrastructure and customers: PGN, PLN EPI, approved private pipeline/LNG operators, distributors and Jargas providers.
accountability_routes.oversight: DPR XII gas and pipeline policy; DPR VI state corporate operators; DPD II regional gas-network equity, industry access and consumer service.
accountability_routes.regional: Provincial LNG terminals, gas pipeline rights of way, industrial clusters, household connections and regional local permits within delegated jurisdiction.
accountability_routes.assessment: Track upstream gas production, gas sold domestically, industrial HGBT allocations, pipeline capacity/throughput and realized Jargas connections as distinct series. An LNG contract or announced LNG project is not proof of domestic gas actually delivered.

bp_bumn.share: Series A Dwiwarna (special rights / 1% in the state-shareholding model)
bp_bumn.role: SOE regulation and strategic state-shareholder rights, subject to each company's structure

danantara.share: Series B (99% of the law-defined split of state shareholding interests; verify each SOE's total issued shares)
danantara.role: Portfolio management and operational / investment holding mandates for BUMN

boundaries: Not a blanket chart of statutory reporting lines
Not all project entities are BUMN
Independent Indonesian BUMS and foreign operators are not Danantara subsidiaries
SKK Migas and BPH Migas execute government regulatory mandates, not BUMN portfolio operations
Do not read 99% Danantara Series B as 99% of the entire publicly traded equity capital of every listed SOE; issuer ownership tables and public free float must be checked individually.

policies.note: Curated official-law and policy register; 2026 references are placed alongside still-applicable framework rules from earlier years. Enacted decisions, appointments, projects and draft proposals are distinctly labeled. Legal framework ≠ verified project implementation. The scheduled source watch surfaces candidate releases, not automatic legal status updates.

items.title: Presidential direction: PLN transformation and accelerated 100 GW solar initiative
items.instrument: Presidential instruction / 14 October official press release
items.effect: Strategic directive on PLN model, efficiency and 100 GW solar ambition. NOT a verified financed or commissioned 100 GW construction programme.

items.title: New coordinating ministry for downstreaming and energy transition
items.instrument: Keppres No. 104/P/2026 · appointment and dual ministerial mandate
items.effect: Bahlil appointed Menko Hilirisasi & Transisi Energi while retaining Minister of ESDM; introduces coordination of energy transition with industrial downstreaming across ministries.

items.title: PLN leadership transition — Suroso Isnandar appointed President Director
items.instrument: PLN Extraordinary GMS (RUPSLB); corporate governance change, not energy regulation
items.effect: PLN head changes from Darmawan Prasodjo to Suroso Isnandar; monitor continuity of RUPTL implementation, project procurement and solar expansion. Do not interpret this as a change in enacted energy policy.

items.title: October 2026 HBA / mineral reference price decree
items.effect: First October 2026 pricing reference; not a new coal royalty law or confirmed realized transaction price.

items.title: PLN Q4 2026 nonsubsidized electricity tariffs unchanged
items.instrument: ESDM electricity tariff decision; underlying Permen ESDM 7/2024
items.effect: 13 non-subsidized tariff classes remain at Q3 2026 levels for October–December; monitor fiscal and PLN cost implications.

items.title: ESDM enforcement authority delegation
items.effect: Delegates specified authority in ESDM law enforcement; scope must be read from decree before inferring sector-specific sanctions.

items.title: Government directs preparatory work on E50
items.instrument: National Energy Council plenary / ESDM press statement
items.effect: E50 ethanol blending is under preparation; do not describe it as mandatory retail blending or commercial rollout.

items.title: CCS sector carbon-value implementation under development
items.instrument: ESDM CCS policy statement linked to Perpres 110/2025
items.effect: Proposed inclusion of CCS/CCUS as energy-sector mitigation under carbon-value rules; no assumption of automatic carbon-credit eligibility.

items.title: Crude oil, transport fuel and LPG procurement for national supply resilience
items.effect: Regulates domestic and imported procurement of crude oil, transport fuels and LPG to sustain refinery feedstock and consumer/industrial fuel availability. Procurement arrangements are not proof of physical supply sufficiency.
items.title_id: Pengadaan minyak mentah, BBM, dan LPG untuk ketahanan pasokan nasional
items.effect_id: Mengatur pengadaan minyak mentah, BBM, dan LPG dari dalam negeri maupun impor untuk menjamin kebutuhan kilang serta pasokan masyarakat dan industri. Peraturan ini tidak otomatis membuktikan kecukupan pasokan fisik.

items.title: Risk-based business licensing standards in ESDM sector
items.effect: Sectoral licensing standards; distinguish CCS site-specific permissions from broad registration or commercial start.

items.title: Updated national carbon economic value framework
items.effect: Supersedes Perpres 98/2021; specific CCS carbon-credit treatment needs implementing rules and eligibility review.

items.title: Updated National Energy Policy (KEN)
items.effect: Changes national planning benchmark; avoid treating older RUEN 23% EBT 2025 as the sole governing target.

items.title: CCS storage non-tax state revenue framework
items.effect: Establishes relevant PNBP basis; verify tariff applicability and licensing for individual storage schemes.

items.title: Carbon-storage permit areas (WIPK)
items.effect: Rules governing carbon storage permit areas; distinct from upstream PSC CCS approval pathway.

items.title: National CCS activity framework
items.effect: Governs CCS, including cross-border storage provisions and domestic-priority constraints; permissions and bilateral conditions require verification.

items.title: CCS/CCUS in upstream oil and gas operations
items.effect: Upstream PSC CCS/CCUS procedure, technical obligations and monitoring duties.

items.title: Oil and gas sector legal framework — as amended and subject to constitutional decisions
items.title_id: Kerangka UU Migas — beserta perubahan dan putusan konstitusional
items.instrument: UU No. 22/2001 · amended most recently by UU No. 6/2023
items.effect: Foundation for upstream/downstream activities; read with later amendments and Constitutional Court decisions, including the invalidation of BP Migas provisions. Do not present the 2001 original text as wholly unchanged.
items.effect_id: Landasan kegiatan hulu dan hilir migas; harus dibaca bersama perubahan terbaru dan putusan Mahkamah Konstitusi, termasuk pembatalan ketentuan BP Migas. Jangan anggap naskah 2001 tidak berubah.

items.title: Upstream licensing, production-sharing arrangements and field operations
items.title_id: Ketentuan hulu: wilayah kerja, kontrak, dan operasi lapangan
items.instrument: PP No. 35/2004 · amended by PP No. 34/2005 & PP No. 55/2009
items.effect: Framework for exploration and exploitation of oil and gas. The amended framework governs upstream contract/operating arrangements; it is distinct from the downstream fuels regime.
items.effect_id: Kerangka eksplorasi dan eksploitasi migas, termasuk hubungan kontraktual serta operasi hulu, sebagaimana telah diubah. Berbeda dari ketentuan pengolahan dan distribusi BBM di hilir.

items.title: Downstream processing, transport, storage and trading framework
items.title_id: Kerangka hilir: pengolahan, pengangkutan, penyimpanan, dan niaga
items.instrument: PP No. 36/2004 · amended by PP No. 30/2009
items.effect: Sets the downstream business framework, including processing/refining, logistics, storage, licensing and trading. Facility nameplate capacity is not evidence of fuel deliveries.
items.effect_id: Mengatur usaha pengolahan/kilang, pengangkutan, penyimpanan, perizinan, dan niaga migas. Kapasitas desain fasilitas tidak sama dengan realisasi penyaluran BBM.

items.title: SKK Migas upstream institutional governance and PSC oversight
items.title_id: Tata kelola SKK Migas dan pengawasan kontrak kerja sama hulu
items.instrument: Perpres No. 9/2013 · amended by Perpres No. 36/2018
items.effect: Provides the institutional framework for managing upstream cooperation contracts through SKK Migas under government oversight, following Constitutional Court changes to BP Migas. This is not a new 2026 appointment.
items.effect_id: Mengatur pengelolaan kontrak kerja sama hulu melalui SKK Migas setelah perubahan kelembagaan akibat putusan MK. Bukan keputusan pengangkatan pejabat pada 2026.

items.title: Updated gross-split production-sharing contracts
items.title_id: Pembaharuan kontrak bagi hasil gross split
items.effect: Updates the gross-split framework, revenue sharing, contractor obligations and investment risk allocation; supersedes the older Permen ESDM 8/2017 gross-split regulation. Individual contracts may have transitional provisions.
items.effect_id: Memperbarui mekanisme gross split, pembagian hasil, kewajiban kontraktor, dan alokasi risiko investasi. Menggantikan aturan gross split 8/2017; kontrak berjalan dapat memiliki ketentuan transisi.

items.title: Rokan nonconventional oil and gas upstream acceleration
items.title_id: Percepatan migas nonkonvensional di Wilayah Kerja Rokan
items.effect: Ministerial decision specifically concerns the acceleration of nonconventional oil and gas development in the Rokan working area. It does not verify commercial-scale production or realized incremental output.
items.effect_id: Keputusan Menteri mengenai percepatan migas nonkonvensional Wilayah Kerja Rokan. Belum menjadi bukti produksi komersial atau tambahan produksi yang terealisasi.

items.title: Downstream natural-gas business and pipeline-commercial framework
items.title_id: Kerangka pengusahaan gas bumi di hilir dan niaga melalui pipa
items.instrument: Permen ESDM No. 4/2018 · amended by Permen ESDM No. 19/2021
items.effect: Regulates downstream gas commercial activities, distribution and consumer supply as updated in 2021. Pricing, customer connections and physical flow should be separately verified.
items.effect_id: Mengatur kegiatan pengusahaan gas bumi di hilir, distribusi dan penyaluran kepada konsumen sebagaimana diubah pada 2021. Harga, sambungan pelanggan, dan volume aliran harus diuji terpisah.

items.title: Household and small-customer natural gas network (Jargas) provision
items.title_id: Penyediaan Jargas bagi rumah tangga dan pelanggan kecil
items.effect: Policy framework for supplying and distributing natural gas through transmission/distribution networks to households and small customers. Project targets and installed customer connections are not interchangeable.
items.effect_id: Landasan penyediaan dan distribusi gas melalui jaringan bagi rumah tangga dan pelanggan kecil. Target sambungan dan sambungan terpasang tidak boleh dicampur.

items.title: Industry-specific natural gas users and HGBT price-setting mechanism
items.title_id: Penetapan pengguna dan Harga Gas Bumi Tertentu (HGBT) industri
items.instrument: Permen ESDM No. 15/2022 · replaces Permen No. 8/2020
items.effect: Specifies eligible users and procedures for setting differentiated gas prices in industry. A legal price mechanism is distinct from actual 2026 plant-gate tariffs, delivered volumes and each eligible firm's effective decision.
items.effect_id: Mengatur pengguna dan tata cara penetapan harga gas untuk industri tertentu. Mekanisme hukum berbeda dari tarif plant gate aktual 2026, volume tersalur, dan keputusan bagi masing-masing penerima.

items.title: Updated HGBT beneficiary designation and differentiated industrial gas reference
items.title_id: Perubahan penerima HGBT dan penetapan harga gas industri berdasarkan pemanfaatan
items.effect: Official ministerial decision revised beneficiary list for seven industrial sectors; ESDM announced differentiated references US$7/MMBtu for fuel and US$6.5/MMBtu for feedstock as of February 2025. These are dated references and not a validated October 2026 price for every buyer.
items.effect_id: Keputusan Menteri mengubah daftar penerima HGBT di tujuh sektor industri. ESDM menyebut acuan Februari 2025 sebesar US$7/MMBtu untuk bahan bakar dan US$6,5/MMBtu untuk bahan baku; bukan harga Oktober 2026 yang telah diverifikasi bagi seluruh pelanggan.

items.title: BPH Migas revokes six specific household pipeline-gas price regulations
items.title_id: BPH Migas mencabut enam aturan harga gas rumah tangga tertentu
items.effect: Repeals six specific previous BPH Migas regulations on consumer gas prices through designated household distribution pipelines. Does not abolish the national Jargas programme or all household pipeline gas tariff decisions.
items.effect_id: Mencabut enam peraturan BPH Migas terdahulu yang mengatur harga gas pipa rumah tangga pada jaringan tertentu. Bukan penghapusan program Jargas nasional atau seluruh ketentuan tarif gas rumah tangga.

oil_gas_review.scope: Upstream, downstream, BBM/LPG procurement, HGBT, gas pipelines/Jargas, new and inherited legal instruments
oil_gas_review.method: Curated links from Indonesian official law repositories and MEMR; amendments and court decisions noted; dated rules are not assumed to establish realized sectoral outcomes
oil_gas_review.warning: Legal status as checked on reference date; future supersession, tariff changes and implementation require renewed official checking.

ccs.note: Geological resource estimates are NOT certified injectable capacity. Project announcements, FID, pilot injectivity, operating injection, realized capital expenditure and measured cumulative tonnes are different evidence classes.

target.text: Approximately 15 potential CCS/CCUS developments targeting the 2026–2030 window (2024 policy aspiration, not evidence that 15 have commenced operation).

realized.note: No independently reconciled national commercial injected CO₂ total, operational facility count or CCS-only realized CAPEX was established from the cited public sources as of this snapshot. NULL / unverified does NOT mean zero. Earlier injections may have occurred in pilots and must not be counted as commercial scale.

projects.name: Tangguh Ubadari–CCUS–Compression (UCC)
projects.investment_basis: 2024 FID for bundled Ubadari gas field + CCUS + compression; NOT CCS-only capex and NOT verified realized spending
projects.storage_basis: Potential sequestration in initial phase, not injected volume
projects.target: Ubadari first gas expected 2028; CCUS injection commissioning date not independently confirmed from cited source
projects.realization: No verified commercial CO₂ injection volume in the primary announcement

projects.name: Jatibarang injectivity / CO₂ EOR preparedness
projects.operator: Pertamina EP Regional 2 Zone 7; PDSI test support
projects.partners: Pertamina Hulu Energi and Pertamina Drilling Services Indonesia
projects.storage_basis: Water injectivity does not establish CO₂ storage volume
projects.target: Further CO₂ injection readiness subject to technical and commercial validation
projects.realization: Water injectivity test at JTB-156 on 14 July 2026, not evidence of commercial CO₂ storage

projects.name: Gundih CCUS / EGR
projects.partners: ITB, JGC, J-Power and JANUS; Japan METI-linked studies
projects.status: Study / pre-FEED and earlier technical pilots
projects.investment_basis: ESDM historical modeled injection investment is not booked CAPEX
projects.storage_basis: Historical indicative 3 Mt CO₂ over 10 years; not certified capacity
projects.realization: Historical pilot-study references exist; no commercial-scale tonnage verified here

projects.name: Sukowati CO₂-EOR / CCUS
projects.storage_basis: Historic indicative 14 Mt (15-year profile in technical listing); do not sum as committed
projects.target: Legacy pilot target 2026–2027; full scale around 2030/2031, subject to updated project disclosure
projects.realization: No confirmed commercial injection documented in cited material

projects.name: Abadi Masela gas development with planned CCS
projects.status: Wider gas project groundbreaking 2026; CCS not proven operational
projects.investment_basis: 2026 publicly stated ENTIRE Abadi Masela gas/LNG project value, not CCS project capex or money realized
projects.storage_basis: Reservoir CO₂ reinjection envisaged; verified commercial storage volume not provided
projects.target: Planned CCS from start of LNG production; date pending execution milestones
projects.realization: 16 July 2026 groundbreaking of broader gas project, NOT inauguration of CCS injection

projects.name: Sunda Asri / Asri Basin carbon storage hub
projects.operator: Pertamina / ExxonMobil collaboration (project model subject to approvals)
projects.partners: Pertamina, ExxonMobil; other emitters subject to commercial agreements
projects.investment_basis: No verified sanctioned or realized CCS-only CAPEX in cited public statements
projects.storage_basis: Basin resource estimates are not approved project capacity
projects.target: Hub ambition; no verified first-injection date
projects.realization: Agreement and studies, not proof of operational storage

projects.name: Arun / Aceh CCS evaluation
projects.operator: Pema Global Energi (PGE) — field study track
projects.partners: BPMA, technical and prospective strategic partners
projects.target: A BPMA 2025 report discussed pilot 2027, full-scale ambition 2030; targets not verified achievements
projects.realization: 2025 statement of interest and geological field studies, not commercial injection

assessment: Supply-side resource potential is enormous on a basin-screening basis, but permits, injectivity, site integrity, CO₂ capture and transport economics determine bankable storage.
Indonesia has progressed from studies to a major integrated FID (Tangguh UCC); its US$7bn bundle must not be misrepresented as spent CCS-only investment.
Operational conversion remains the principal uncertainty: require named wells, meter-verified tonnes injected, MRV reports, permit conditions and liability arrangements.
Compare CO₂ transport cost and industrial capture economics with domestic energy-security and carbon-market rules; avoid counting potential storage as emissions abated.
Projects tied to oil/gas recovery warrant separate attribution of avoided emissions versus incremental hydrocarbon production and full lifecycle effects.
Partner mapping matters: bp (Tangguh), Pertamina and technical partners (Jatibarang, Gundih, Sukowati), INPEX/Pertamina/PETRONAS (Masela), and Pertamina–ExxonMobil (Sunda Asri).
